title: Aperiodic Thickness-Optimized Dichroic Stack
scientific_hypothesis: Allowing individual layer thicknesses to vary independently (breaking periodicity) will achieve sharper band-edge transition between 700 nm reflection cutoff and 1530 nm transmission onset compared to periodic Bragg design.
design_principle: Needle optimization and aperiodic designs (L34 mentions needle optimization for HfO2/SiO2) can achieve spectral shapes unattainable with fixed periodicity. L09 demonstrates RL-driven multi-objective optimization for composite thin films.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (12 pairs, 24 layers total)
design_variables: individual thickness of each of the 24 layers (independent optimization)
soft_objectives: Minimize transition width between 700 nm and 1530 nm
manufacturing_considerations: Individual thicknesses must remain manufacturable (not sub-nm)
HfO2/SiO2 deposition control demonstrated in L16, L25
expected_advantages: L09 shows optimization framework can handle multi-band requirements
execution_request_english: Design an aperiodic multilayer dielectric stack with air incidence on fused silica substrate. Stack: 12 alternating pairs of HfO2 and SiO2 (Lemarchand) (24 layers total), starting with HfO2. Each of the 24 layers has an independently optimizable physical thickness. Optimize all 24 thicknesses simultaneously to maximize transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band while maximizing reflectance in 400-700 nm band. Layer count fixed at 24. Materials: hfo2, SiO2 (Lemarchand).
